Membership

Who administers this site, and who gets past the group check. These are the lists that used to live in the Cloudflare dashboard.

The numeric id, not the @handle. It is sent once, hashed by the Worker, and never stored or shown again — not in the list below, and not here.

Rows that grant nothing

        

          These rows are in the table and grant nothing, because their
          account id is not the sixty-four lowercase hex characters the
          Worker honors. wrangler d1 execute writes such a
          row without complaint, so this is how one arrives. They are
          worth removing before the admin list becomes the only
          authority: the guard that refuses to remove the last admin row
          counts these too.
        

        

      


      

        

          This answer also carried something this page cannot draw. It is
          shown as it arrived rather than dropped: a row here still
          grants whatever its role says, and a grant no screen shows is
          the failure this pane exists to end.

Result

      

      
      

        Download CSV
        Download Excel
        Download JSON
      

      

        Excel keeps the numbers as numbers, so a weight sorts as a weight
        and a handle of digits stays a handle. CSV is plain text that
        anything can read. JSON keeps the nesting the other two have to
        flatten — use it if something other than a person is going to
        read this.

Publish

      

        Sends the charts above — as counts and medians, with no handles
        and no rows — to the public Progress
        page. It replaces whatever is there now.
      


      

        
        

          Published as “Person 1”, “Person 2” — never handles — and each
          point is rounded to a date and a histogram bin, so following
          one person across two snapshots is an inference rather than a
          join. It is not impossible: anyone who knows what someone
          weighs may recognize their line, and publishing twice still
          discloses more than publishing once. Fewer than five lines
          publishes no chart at all. Off by default for those reasons.
        

      


      

        
        
      


      


      

    


    
    

      
Before you close this

      

        This page is the only place the submissions exist in the clear.
        Closing the tab discards everything decrypted here, and the admin
        session is tab-scoped too — but the key is not. Once you import
        it, it stays on this device so later exports need no file, and
        Clear is what removes it. Press Clear before you
        leave this browser on a machine someone else can reach. Keep your
        key file as well: the browser may drop stored data, and the file
        is what puts the key back.
